memories.title: First drink, first SDE job
memories.note: Landed my first SDE role at a startup. Worked like crazy, but proud of every bit of it. Cheers to the start, and the pain.

memories.title: Handing opencode to our juniors
memories.note: After a year of leading it, we passed the club on. Easily the most talented team we've had in years.

memories.title: Led a national-level hackathon
memories.note: From taking part to running one, with my fellow bakchods. Months of prep and stress for three days. Could have been better, but it taught me a lot about this community. Respect to every hackathon organiser.

memories.title: My first LEGO F1 builds
memories.note: A LEGO fan since I was a kid, but it was always too expensive. Built the McLaren and Ferrari with what was left after the MacBook. Slow to build, pure joy.

memories.title: Bought my dream MacBook
memories.note: Paid for with freelance and internship money: all-nighters, missed classes and all. My first proper work setup, and a proud one.

memories.title: H4B 2025, our first offline hackathon
memories.note: Summer vacation with the club's bakchod gang. The train ran 12 hours late thanks to the weather. Worth every hour.

memories.title: My first public session, on web3
memories.note: Streamed live for opencode: a whole series from web3 basics to how it all actually works. Good old ETH days.

memories.title: Ran hack-inno, our first hackathon
memories.note: Second year, leading the team behind our first intra-college hackathon. Registration desks by day, all-night majdoori by night. It worked.

memories.title: First SIH, three ideas, one all-nighter
memories.note: Changed our idea three times overnight in the BM/BT complex. Didn't get selected. Still one hell of a night.

memories.title: Joined opencode, my first tech club
memories.note: First year, first tech club, first bakchod friends. What a time. Where the whole tech journey started.
